sources.title: 6block/MiniMax-H3-Qwen3-VL-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An NVFP4 (4-bit) Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder for MiniMax-H3, made with convert-to-quant. It is a drop-in replacement for the H3 conditioning text encoder (ComfyUI CLIPLoader, type minimax). The H3 video weights are unchanged — only the text encoder is quantized to 4-bit, to bring the full H3 stack onto consumer GPUs.
